paragraphs.text: Abian is a monstrous non- humanoid planeswalker with control over spirits who has usurped the plane of Luvion .

The character of Abian was created by Wizards of the Coast for a Mystery Booster playtest card Abian, Luvion Usurper . He is a very stocky creature that is larger than a human and has claws. As playtest cards are normally non-canonical, his actual control or existence on Luvion is dubious unless otherwise confirmed. When played, Abian has a unique effect of having the player become Abian - making them both a player and permanent - with their life total becoming equal to his loyalty and life gain or loss affecting it as well.
